units.title: A positive tilt matches the Poisson denominator
units.reader_note: This supplies the positive tilt and scalar matching for Eq23; the actual sphere/Poisson integral remains open.
units.statement: The selected positive tilt puts the Gaussian denominator into the source Poisson-kernel form.
assumptions: Every subtraction and division involving \(n\) is real arithmetic after coercion. The matching variable \(u\) is any real number. No domain estimate is supplied as a premise.

notation.text: Literal source parameter choices; s is shorthand for the real square root.
Affine denominator from the already formalized Gaussian transform.

steps.title: Establish the parameter domains
steps.text: The standing source assumptions keep every denominator away from zero. These are conclusions derived internally, not extra caller premises.
steps.formula: s=\sqrt\kappa\ge2,\quad s^2=\kappa,\quad n\ge3,\quad n>0,\quad n-1>0,\quad s-1>0.
steps.lean: hs, hs2, hn3, hn0 and hn1 use the canonical Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le and Real.sq_sqrt declarations and real arithmetic.

steps.title: Shrink the spectral ratio
steps.text: Both factors defining r lie strictly between zero and one. Rewrite r into a single rational expression for later normalization.
steps.lean: hfactor, hfactor1, hratio and hratio1 use positive division; hr, hr1 and hreq establish the exact source radius and its domain.

steps.title: Choose a strictly positive tilt
steps.text: The closed-form numerator is positive and its denominator is positive. Clearing these established nonzero denominators recovers the other presentation of the same source tilt.
steps.lean: hℓ proves positivity from the literal formula. hell rewrites kappa=s² and the exact hreq radius; field arithmetic checks the equality.

steps.title: Normalize the positive coefficient
steps.text: Factor the spectral difference and cancel only factors already proved nonzero. This makes explicit the scalar coefficient equality underlying the second source line of Eq23.
steps.lean: hcoeff uses hs2 and hreq followed by canonical field normalization. This is supplied scalar bookkeeping, not an additional displayed source theorem or a sphere-law assertion.

steps.title: Match the entire affine denominator
steps.text: Substitute the recovered tilt formula, collect the affine terms, and replace the coefficient. The calculation is valid for any real u. Positivity for arbitrary real u is not claimed; the source later uses its bounded actual coordinate U.
steps.lean: The final forall-u block expands hell and then rewrites hcoeff. The separate actual_gaussian_transform consumer can use the proved ell>0; Poisson evaluation and Eq24 are not inferred.

units.lean_statement: Only the standing n and kappa assumptions; all positivity and matching are conclusions.
units.lean_proof: Positive rational factors and canonical square-root/field arithmetic.
units.boundary: Selected numerical tilt and all Eq22–23 scalar matching only. No sphere law/Poisson integral, Eq24 H evaluation, actual TV first ratio, amplification, transcript/query/cost, hidden-eigenbasis or main lower bound. Source zero-tilt remark is context, not an extra conclusion.
